systems.country_label: chaîne de production des documents de voyage
systems.owner: Commissariat Général des Migrations, under the interior ministry; run entirely by its own staff since the Contec Global contract expired
systems.tiers: Commissariat Général des Migrations headquarters; applications made online, collection in person

note: Interior ministry news item on passport production at the Commissariat Général des Migrations (500 passports a day, 11,000 approved files, about 40,000 applicants waiting, as at 9 March 2023). An immigration service, out of scope; nothing on station records.
